page_title: DOR 4-2 UNI | Dortmund v Union Berlin 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Patrick Ittrich who sees an offensive foul.
90+2' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' An attempted cross from Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
86' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.

84' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
83' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) replacing Marco Reus.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug will be replaced by Sebastien Haller (Dortmund).
82' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Gregor Kobel thwarts him and the score remains the same.
80' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Gregor Kobel (Dortmund).
80' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' The corner from Marco Reus (Dortmund) is hurriedly cleared.

78' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
73' Edin Terzic has decided to substitute Mats Hummels and he is replaced by Niklas Sule (Dortmund).
71' 4 - 2 GOAL 4:2! Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) unleashes a shot from distance, which is deflected past Frederik Ronnow. He had no chance of stopping it as the ball rapidly changed its direction.
68' Here's the change. Christopher Trimmel leaves the pitch and Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
68' Sheraldo Becker will be replaced by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
68' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) replaces Kevin Behrens.

66' Sheraldo Becker plays a pass to Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
64' Substitution. Donyell Malen walks off the pitch and Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
64' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
59' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Marco Reus (Dortmund) took the corner.

59' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is replacing Aissa Laidouni.
54' 3 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) was set free in the area by Marco Reus and fired past Frederik Ronnow. 3:2.
52' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
51' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
49' 2 - 2 Nice piece of skill by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) as he collected a pass and fired an unstoppable thunderbolt into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
48' Chance! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
46' Edin Terzic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) comes on the pitch for Jamie Bynoe-Gittens.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45+4' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45+3' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

45+3' What a great effort! Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
45+2' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+1' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

43' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Gregor Kobel allowed him to make a comfortable save.
43' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
40' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
39' Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to release Donyell Malen with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
36' A pass by Marius Wolf (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
34' Marco Reus (Dortmund) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
31' 1 - 2 Goal! Leonardo Bonucci (Union Berlin) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Gregor Kobel to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
31' Leonardo Bonucci (Union Berlin) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' The Union Berlin players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

30' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Union Berlin.
29' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
28' The goal by Dortmund won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
27' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich has indicated he is going to review the Dortmund goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
27' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header inside the right post.
25' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Union Berlin due to an offside in the build-up play.
20' Urs Fischer is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alex Kral suffers an injury and Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) comes on.
18' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Union Berlin players aren’t happy.
18' The ball from the free kick finds its way to Alex Kral (Union Berlin) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!

16' That didn't go as planned! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Frederik Ronnow, who easily kept it out.
12' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

9' 1 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top right corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:1.
8' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' 1 - 0 One of the defending players blocked the first attempt, but the ball lands at the feet of Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) and he unleashes a shot which goes in off the bottom of the right post.
7' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Frederik Ronnow.
7' Marco Reus (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
7' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Dortmund will take a corner kick.
6' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

5' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
4' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Emre Can (Dortmund) swings it in and Donyell Malen gets on the end of it, but Frederik Ronnow shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
2' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will officiate today.
